##### Project general facts

Fahid Beach Residences by Aldar is a seafront residential community at the heart of an island destination, designed by the internationally acclaimed architect Koichi Takada. Contemporary coastal architecture with clean lines, panoramic facades, light materials and generous glazing frames endless sea views. The community comprises seven buildings, each rising above a ground floor and a podium level to ten residential floors, and offers one- to four-bedroom apartments, one- and two-bedroom townhouses and five-bedroom penthouses.

Amenities are designed to support vitality and calm. Residents can enjoy infinity pools, jacuzzis, kids' swimming pools and splash pads, an outdoor kids' play area and kids' rooms, together with gyms, outdoor fitness areas and squash courts. A sauna and steam room, a cinema room, co-working lounges, multipurpose rooms, social kitchens, landscaped podium gardens and a pet spa complete the offer, while high-calibre food and beverage outlets and community events add a lively atmosphere.

Interiors prioritise eco-friendly materials and natural light, with a breezy, beach-inspired palette, Italian brands and premium built-in appliances creating refined, comfortable homes. Generous windows and balconies open towards the sea and the landscaped gardens. Residents benefit from round-the-clock security and concierge, visitor and retail valet services, and direct access to the waterfront promenade and the island's retail boulevard. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Fahid Island is a wellness-led island destination off the coast of Abu Dhabi, set between Yas Island and Saadiyat Island. Restorative gardens, green trails, beaches and protected native ecosystems cover much of the island, while a waterfront promenade, a marina and the Coral Drive boulevard with its boutiques and restaurants create a vibrant beach culture for residents and visitors throughout the year.

Yas Island with its theme parks, Yas Mall and Yas Marina is a short drive away, while Saadiyat Island, Zayed International Airport and the centre of Abu Dhabi are within easy reach. King's College School Wimbledon, Flora Mall and a five-star beach resort are planned on the island, and Dubai is within comfortable driving distance for weekend trips and business travel.

Fahid Island is an investment zone open to international buyers, recognised for its leading sustainability certifications and wellness-focused masterplan. Seafront homes close to Yas Island and Saadiyat Island are in limited supply, supporting demand from families, professionals and holiday home buyers. A strong lifestyle offer and the backing of a leading master developer underpin long-term value and rental prospects for owners.
